page.overview:
Who is Izukanne?

Izukanne is a Giovanni necromancer of the Ghiberti family line. He resides in Africa where he has a tense relationship with the Laibon.

Izukanne was Embraced by Magno di Giovanni in the early 18th century. He earned the eternal enmity of his people by playing an integral role in trafficking West African slaves for the Dutch. He does not allow mortal ethics to weigh on his conscience and is a firm adherent to the Path of Death and the Soul.

His modern infamy revolves around his mastery of the Cenotaph Path and his personal possession of over 100 wraith fetters. He replaced one of his biological eyes with an ivory sphere, which serves as the fetter of a Dutch slaver named Constantijn Quaeckernaeck. This modified eye allows him to discern whether a target is easily dominated into subservience.

Izukanne has a long-standing reputation for necromantic enslavement and a protracted war with the Laibon of Nigeria. Observers such as Beckett have noted rumors that Izukanne holds a blood bond over Strohmann, the self-styled "Archbishop" of Berlin and a fellow enslaver.
